summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (96/189)

data.turoyo: Hano ste, Nari, kətle kamana mani b iḏe, gmoḥe aʕla. Məqam bi arʕo layt, d lo mopəq.
data.translation: Nari hatte eine Fiedel, auf der er mit der Hand zu spielen pflegte. Es gab keine Weise auf Erden, die er nicht herausbrachte.

rationale: First III Infectum context; musical theme extension.

data.turoyo: Mopaqli ṣawʕi, grəšle ṣawʕi, i ʕisaqṯayḏi šmiṭo m iḏi w u səḥər diḏi tle.
data.translation: Ich streckte meinen Finger hervor, er zog an meinem Finger, mein Ring streifte sich ab, und mein Zauber wurde aufgehoben.

rationale: Thin Preterit cell; protruding finger, retrieved object, and rescued person provide different argument contexts.

data.turoyo: I ḥreto mzalṭalla ruḥa, mḥalaqla ruḥa bu baḥar, mopaqla i xanǧar du aḥuno mu baḥar.
data.translation: Da zog die andere sich aus, sprang ins Meer und holte den Dolch des Bruders aus dem Meere heraus.

rationale: Thin Preterit cell; protruding finger, retrieved object, and rescued person provide different argument contexts.

data.turoyo: Hama šməṭle aǧ ǧulayḏe, mḥalaqle ruḥe bu baḥar l Titəlyos lu waziro, mawpaqle u zlamano Marzawan mu baḥar.
data.translation: er zog sich die Kleideraus, sprang ins Meer und holte den Mann, Marzawan, aus dem Meereheraus. -

rationale: Thin Preterit cell; protruding finger, retrieved object, and rescued person provide different argument contexts.

summary: All six occurrences checked. Keep the p-forms mopaqli/mopaqla/mawpaqle and inherited npq III forms without changing them to f. The fuller synonymous nfq paradigm raises a variant question, not authority to merge entries.
Source m- marks the pool/sea from which a snake, dagger or person is brought out. A zero-marked finger object can instead be protruded; the same inherited broad sense covers it.
96/320 and 96/322 recount the same dagger retrieval. Select the direct narrative instead of adding its repetition merely to reach five.
The musical məqam proposal is an extension, and the first local III Infectum example. The permitted məqam glossary search was checked for established collocations.
The empty I section contains inherited base forms but no supplied occurrence or gloss. Preserve the placeholder; do not manufacture a sense or an example for it.
Should npq be cross-referenced to nfq as a p/f variant while preserving source spellings and example IDs?
Does mopəq məqam name a conventional musical technique or simply performing a tune? One occurrence does not establish a separate technical lexical meaning.
A melody can be brought out on a fiddle. Treat this as a musical-theme extension of herausbringen, not a new technical sense on one non-metalinguistic attestation.
